+"""
+flaskbb/utils/rate_limit.py
+
+In-memory sliding-window rate limiter for the login endpoint.
+Keyed by remote IP address. Not persistent across restarts.
+"""
+from collections import defaultdict
+from functools import wraps
+from time import time
+
+from flask import jsonify, request
+
+_attempts: dict = defaultdict(list)
+LOGIN_LIMIT = 5
+LOGIN_WINDOW = 600  # seconds (10 minutes)
+
+
+def rate_limit_login(f):
+    """Decorator: block an IP after LOGIN_LIMIT attempts within LOGIN_WINDOW seconds."""
+    @wraps(f)
+    def decorated(*args, **kwargs):
+        ip = request.remote_addr
+        now = time()
+        # Evict timestamps outside the current window
+        _attempts[ip] = [t for t in _attempts[ip] if now - t < LOGIN_WINDOW]
+        if len(_attempts[ip]) >= LOGIN_LIMIT:
+            return jsonify({"error": "Too many login attempts. Try again later."}), 429
+        _attempts[ip].append(now)
+        return f(*args, **kwargs)
+    return decorated
